description: 6x2 4bpp BI_RLE4 with a nibble-alternating encoded run and an odd-length absolute run
notes: The encoded run repeats the two nibbles of 0x12 as 1,2,1,2,1,2 — high nibble first. The absolute run of 5 packs into 3 bytes, so it needs a pad byte to reach a WORD boundary; a decoder that computes bytes as n/2 rather than ceil(n/2) desynchronises here.
